approval.statement: P9 execution authorization adopts these previously recorded provisional values after the pilot checks passed. The checkpoint rule was not changed.

dqn.target_sync_rule: After each training episode, copy online weights to the target network.
dqn.checkpoint_rule: Online weights after episode 500. Intermediate weights were not compared.

energy_under_latency_ceiling.threshold_rule: Median of the 18 heuristic mean_latency_s values on the three pilot instances.
energy_under_latency_ceiling.selection: Minimum energy_j among runs at or below the threshold; run_id ascending breaks ties. Report none when no run qualifies.

dqn_minus_heuristic.supersedes: The version 1 sentence that named no instance.
dqn_minus_heuristic.selection: Use the first seed in seed_splits.held_out. Seeds 3000-3011 are low, 3012-3023 are medium, and 3024-3035 are high, matching the seed assignment frozen with version 1. The instance id is provisional-held_out-{intensity}-{seed}.
dqn_minus_heuristic.difference: On that instance, subtract each heuristic M, E, and L from the DQN values.
dqn_minus_heuristic.witness: Keep the full-space witness run ids when the DQN run is dominated. Record an empty list when it is non-dominated.

cases.pair_versus_full: Report a run whose pair label differs from its full-space label. On held-out data, take the first such instance in seed order and otherwise report that none exists.
cases.intensity_comparison: Summarize each intensity separately. Do not place runs from different instances in one Pareto set.

change_record.reason: Version 1 restated the single-instance DQN case and did not record which held-out instance to use. Version 2 adds only that missing selection rule. The seed is the first entry of seed_splits.held_out already stored in version 1. Held-out objective values were not used to choose among instances.
